title: Camera Gear for Art Videos
content: After reading an earlier post calledHow to Video Your Art, Part 1: Camera Guide, blog readerHeatherasked "I was just wondering if you had any new tech to film your videos or if you are still using the same [gear]?"Heather, the most important new tech is theCanon M6camera. This camera is now my main workhorse for art videos.I use my other three cameras for secondary angles or for additional coverage (theGoPro, theCanon PowerShot Elph, and theCanon Vixiacamcorder).One of the features of the M6 that's helpful for art videos is the time lapse function. The way it works is that a built-in intervalometer silently captures one frame per second and automatically compiles the individual frames into a video file.Because it's a mirrorless camera, it's a smaller profile and lighter weight than a regular single-lens-reflex camera. It also captures video at High Definition 1080p at either 30 frames per second or 60fps.
